findings.text: The old awk check never rejected anything, so the check was effectively disabled. The new check actually enforces the character class `[a-zA-Z0-9./_-]`, which excludes `:`, `~`, `%`, `+` and `@` after the scheme. A valid mirror such as `NVM_NODEJS_ORG_MIRROR=http://localhost:8080` or `https://host:8443/dist` now fails with 'may only contain a URL' and return 2, so every `nvm install` or `nvm ls-remote` through that mirror breaks. A mirror URL with userinfo or a `~user` path fails the same way.
